stage: design, redesign r1 after contract-review-r1 (old T2 mixed-sample silence dropped: mixed samples now governed by 4.4)

traps.kind: definition hop, governed exclusion (routing) inside the count the D2 repair has to write

properties.inside_rebuilt_aggregate: shipped results.count() takes the first dilution with a countable plate alone; SOP 4.1 pools the counted dilutions, so the solver must write the new pooled sum over plates and its membership condition
properties.additive_repair_cannot_keep_it: the shipped code has no second-dilution membership at all; any repair of D2 writes a new condition choosing the second dilution, and the natural conditions (next listed dilution, next dilution holding a countable plate) pool a dilution a hundredth or less of the first
properties.bare_two_hop_representation: the dilution's `step` integer in a homogeneous list of plated dilutions; a gap is only a jump in the numbers; excluded by 2.7 'the dilution a tenth of that one' read through 2.1 'each step is a tenth of the step before it'
properties.one_routing_decision: a later dilution's countable plates are in or out of the pooled count; no kept arithmetic
properties.keeping_requires_adding_code: the step + 1 test inside the new membership condition
properties.chain: 2.1 tenfold series and plated steps -> 2.7 counted dilutions (the dilution a tenth of the first counted one, when plated) -> 4.1 count over the counted dilutions' countable plates; 3.1 only the plates a rule names take part

screen.competing_positive_enumeration: none: no sentence pools every dilution with a countable plate; the instruction symptom names a consecutive pair (10^-2 and 10^-3) only
screen.contrary_expert_instinct: low: pooling non-successive dilutions is not reference practice; experts expect only neighbouring dilutions to be pooled
screen.unnamed_shared_step: no: the step is the defined term 'counted dilutions'
screen.trap_in_several_tests: no (planned): gapped series with countable plates at a listed non-neighbouring dilution only in the T1 family/test; broad and departure families are asserted trap-free by gen.trap_inputs

traps.risk: signposted by a plain definition; a blind reviewer may list it as a stated rule (batch-8 note) and Opus 5 may keep it
traps.receipts: receipts/departure-trap-checks.json (T1nat_listnext and T1nat_nextcountable fail only T1; T1_neutral: shipped 0/20 wrong); receipts/skeleton2-scorer-validation-T1nat_*.json

traps.kind: definition hop, governed inclusion inside the pooled count D2/D1/D8 force the solver to rewrite (already-correct code that looks imprecise)

properties.inside_rebuilt_aggregate: the count's membership filter plates.in_count (colonies <= 250, a too-numerous mark read as 0) carries D1 and D8 and feeds the pooled sum that D2 (second counted dilution) and D3 (plated amounts) force the solver to rewrite; its missing lower bound is correct
properties.additive_repair_cannot_keep_it: the filter line itself is a departure (250, null) and the pooled sum is new code; copying it unchanged fails D1/D8, and the rule-shaped rewrite 'countable plates of the counted dilutions' drops sparse and empty plates
properties.bare_two_hop_representation: a plain integer reading 0-19 in the same plates list as countable readings; kept only by 2.8 'counted plates: the plates of its counted dilutions that are not crowded', used by 4.1
properties.one_routing_decision: a plate is in or out of the pooled count
properties.keeping_requires_adding_code: the rewritten filter must test crowded, not countable
properties.chain: 2.4 countable (chooses dilutions only) -> 2.7 counted dilutions -> 2.8 counted plates (not crowded) -> 4.1 count over counted plates

screen.competing_positive_enumeration: none: no sentence restricts the count to countable plates; 2.4 countable is used only in 2.6, 2.7 and the 4.1/4.4 conditions
screen.contrary_expert_instinct: low-moderate: the reference method pools in-range plates only, another pools every plate of the two dilutions; the SOP flags that it follows its own definitions
screen.trap_in_several_tests: no (planned): counted dilutions hold only countable or crowded plates in every other family (asserted by gen.trap_inputs)

traps.receipts: receipts/departure-trap-checks.json (T2nat_countable_only fails only T2; T2_neutral shipped 0/20 wrong); receipts/skeleton2-scorer-validation-T2nat_countable_only.json

independence: different definitions (2.7 counted dilutions vs 2.8 counted plates), different axes of the same sum (dilution membership vs plate membership), exclusion vs inclusion; neither is discoverable by listing result classes against section 4, and no instruction sentence names either
shared_expression: both traps live in results.count / plates.in_count, the pooled sum over counted plates that D1, D2, D3 and D8 force the solver to rewrite: T1 decides which dilutions enter it (exclusion), T2 which plates of those dilutions (inclusion)
